4 IPO listings: Tonbo debuts at 66% premium, Sahajanand & Zetwerk gain; Bonfiglioli disappoints - BusinessToday

## IPO listing today: Tonbo Imaging, Zetwerk, Sahajanand Medical Technologies and Bonfiglioli Transmissions made their market debut on October 23. Check listing prices.

Pawan Kumar Nahar

- Updated Oct 23, 2026 9:54 AM IST

Four companies namely— Tonbo Imaging India, Zetwerk Manufacturing Business, Bonfiglioli Transmissions and Sahajanand Medical Technologies — made their stock market debut on Friday, October 23 after cumulatively raising Rs 8,873 crore from investors between October 15-19. Here's how listing fared for them. 

Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Shares of Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses made a positive stock market debut as the stock was listed with a premium of 5.46 per cent at Rs 159.25 on NSE and with a premium of 5.3 per cent at Rs 159 on NSE against the issue price of Rs 151. Ahead of its listing, it was commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of Rs 1-2 apiece, suggesting a muted listing for the investors.

As of listing price, investors in Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses made a profit of nearly Rs 820 on each lot allotted to them. Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses raised Rs 5,012 crore from its IPO, which was offered in the price band of Rs 143-151 per share with a lot size of 99 equity shares. The issue was subscribed only 3.6 times, fetching little over 1.99 lakh applications during the bidding process.

 Tonbo Imaging India Tonbo Imaging India shares started their market journey on a solid note, listing at a premium of 66 per cent at Rs 1,162 on the BSE and at premium of 65.71 per cent at Rs 1,160 on the BSE against the IPO issue price of Rs 700. The stock had been trading at a grey market premium (GMP) of Rs 450 apiece ahead of its debut, pointing to a potential listing gain of 64-65 per cent.

As of listing price, investors of Tonbo Imaging India made a profit of nearly Rs 9,702 on each lot allotted. Tonbo Imaging India raised Rs 852 crore through its IPO, which was launched in the price band of Rs 665-700 per share with a lot size of 21 shares. The issue received an overall subscription of 135.90 times getting bids worth nearly Rs 80,000 crore through over 55.24 lakh applications.

 Sahajanand Medical Technologies Shares of Sahajanand Medical Technologies made a decent debut on the stock exchanges, listing at a premium of 7.82 per cent at Rs 371.15 on NSE and at 6.99 per cent Rs 368.05 on the BSE against the issue price of Rs 344. In the grey market, the stock was commanding a GMP of Rs 17-20 per share before listing, implying a premium of around 5-6 per cent over the IPO price.

As of listing price, investors of Sahajanand Medical Technologies made a profit of nearly Rs 1,160 on each lot allotted. Sahajanand raised around Rs 475 crore through its IPO, sold in the price band of Rs 327-344 per share with a lot size of 43 equity shares. The IPO saw a subscription of 14.20 times, getting over 3.22 lakh applications and bids worth nearly Rs 4,800 crore.

 Bonfiglioli Transmissions Bonfiglioli Transmissions shares witnessed a muted listing on Friday, debuting at Rs 586 on the NSE and the BSE, which is also the issue price, representing flat debut. However, the listing has been below the expectations. Ahead of the listing, the stock was commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of around Rs 65-70 per share, indicating a positive for the investors.

As of listing price, Bonfiglioli Transmissions investors made a no profit or loss on each lot allotted. Bonfiglioli Transmissions offered its shares was price in the range of Rs 558.586 per share with a lot size of 25 equity shares. Its issue was entirely an offer-for-sale of Rs 2,534 crore. The IPO was subscribed 46.06 times, attracting nearly 34.45 lakh applications and bids worth Rs 81,720 crore.

# Tonbo Imaging shares make stellar market debut; jump 66% 

## The stock made its debut at ₹1,162 apiece, registering a premium of 66% from the issue price on the BSE

### By PTI

 Updated - October 23, 2026 at 12:05 PM.

 | New Delhi 

Shares of Tonbo Imaging India, a defence electronics maker, on Friday listed with a premium of 66 per cent against the issue price of ₹700.

The stock made its debut at ₹1,162 apiece, registering a premium of 66 per cent from the issue price on the BSE.

Later, it traded at ₹1,059.05, down 8.86 per cent from its listing price, still maintaining a premium of 51.28 per cent over its issue price.

On the NSE, the shares opened at ₹1,160 apiece, a jump of 65.71 per cent over the issue price. It was later trading at ₹1,058.30, down by 3.64 per cent from the opening level, but 51.18 per cent higher than the issue price.

Following the listing, the company's market capitalisation stood at ₹6,191.91 crore on the BSE and ₹6,060.45 crore on the NSE.

The broader equity market was trading in the red, with the BSE Sensex falling 409.06 points, or 0.56 per cent, to 72,840.33, while the NSE Nifty dropped 173.65 points, or 0.77 per cent, to 22,514.

...

The ₹852.18-crore initial public offering (IPO) was subscribed nearly 136 times on the final day of bidding on Monday. The public issue was fully subscribed on the first day of bidding on Thursday last week.

The issue comprises an offer-for-sale (OFS) of 1.22 crore equity shares by promoters and existing shareholders, with no fresh issue component.

Since the IPO is entirely an OFS, the company will not receive any proceeds from the issue.

The price band for the IPO has been fixed at ₹665-700 per share.

# IPO 2026 List: All IPOs in 2026 in India at NSE, BSE

Written by Rajat Bhati. Updated on 25 October 2026.

Ninety-six mainboard IPOs listed on NSE and BSE between 19 January and 8 October 2026, against 81 in the same part of 2025. Most of them came late in the year: 23 listed in the first six months and 73 from July onwards, with 32 in September alone.

Sixty-six of the 96 closed their first day above the issue price, and the median listing-day return was 7.48%, up from 5.11% over the same period of 2025. The range is wide. ESDS Software gained 111.75% on 4 September, Shree Ram Twistex lost 31.35% on 2 March, and 12 issues lost 10% or more on day one.

What is the difference between Mainboard and SME IPOs? 

A Mainboard IPO is for large, established companies with a minimum post-issue paid-up capital of ₹10 crore, and these companies list on both NSE and BSE. An SME IPO is for small and medium enterprises with a post-issue paid-up capital of up to ₹25 crore, and these are listed on platforms like NSE Emerge or BSE SME. See the listing requirements for Mainboard and SME IPOs for the full comparison.

 What is the price band and listing date of an IPO? 

The price band is the range within which you can bid for an IPO. The final issue price is decided within this range once bidding closes. The listing date is when the shares start trading on the exchange, usually three working days after the IPO closes.

 How long does an IPO stay open? 

An IPO is usually open for three working days, from its opening date to its closing date. The exact dates are announced along with the price band before the IPO opens.
